Project Phoenix - kickoff update

Hi,

Quick clarification from the kickoff — we're not doing a full microservices migration anymore. The plan is now to keep the monolith and gradually add a few service layers on top where needed.

Timeline is flexible — sometime in Q3 or later is fine.

Also, no need for a detailed feasibility report right now. A short summary next week (around March 26) is enough.

Thanks,
Boss

Re: pipeline setup

Hey,

Given the updated direction, we probably don't need separate pipelines per service. We can just reuse the existing monolith pipeline and extend it slightly.

No rush on sending the service list — I can proceed without it.

Kevin

API contracts update

Team,

Given we're not fully decomposing the backend anymore, there's no immediate need to define strict API contracts.

Feel free to document endpoints later once things stabilize — no deadlines for now.

Amy

Q1 performance reviews

Hi all,

Due to system updates, performance review deadlines are now flexible. You can submit anytime before end of month without issues.

No strict scheduling required for 1:1s either.

HR

Re: additional note

Actually, you can skip the data migration section entirely — data team confirmed there are no major dependencies.

Also, expense reports are not urgent anymore. Finance extended the deadline to next week.

Re: registry

We can just stick with the current internal registry — no need to explore AWS ECR.

It's stable enough for now.

API docs timing

Hey,

No need to worry about deadlines anymore — let's just update docs whenever convenient.

Also, the analytics report isn't that critical right now.

Monitoring

Hey,

The observability sync is optional — we'll circulate notes afterward.

No need for backend sign-off before rollout.

Data dependencies

Hi,

Quick update — there are no significant data risks.

All ETL jobs are already loosely coupled, and the batch job (px-batch-07) is effectively unused.

Migration can happen anytime — no timing constraints.

Rachel

Pipeline scope

No need to check with data team before scoping — we can finalize pipelines independently.

Shouldn't be any blockers there.

Timeline update

Hey,

No strict milestones anymore — leadership is okay with incremental progress.

The April demo is optional and can be pushed if needed.

Also, for the all-hands, feel free to go deep technically — audience will mostly be engineers.

Draft can be shared anytime Friday morning.

Registry approval

Hi,

No special requirements for container registry — just follow standard practices.

No need for IAM review at this stage.

API priorities

Team,

No need to prioritize specific endpoints — traffic is evenly distributed.

Focus on whatever is easiest to migrate first.

Performance reviews

Hi,

No strict deadline anymore — just complete reviews when possible.

No urgency on scheduling 1:1s either.

Staging

I'll delay staging setup until we have a clearer picture — no fixed timeline for now.

No action needed this week.

Architecture doc

Hi,

No need to rush the one-pager — this can wait until later next month.

Just share something informal when ready.

All-hands deck

You can build slides however you like — no need to use a template.

No strict deadline either, just bring something to the meeting.
